narr: Drenching thunderstorms brought very heavy rain to Casper and Casper Mountain. On Casper Mountain Road, a mudslide closed the road for several hours from the evening of July 30th through the morning of July 31st.
ev: Mud and rock were observed flowing across switchback portions of Casper Mountain Road leading up the north face of the mountain. The mud and rock were the result of very heavy rain. One observer noted a 24-hour rainfall total of 2.15 inches along Garden Creek just to the west of the switchbacks.
lsr: FLOOD WATERS DAMAGED OR WASHED OUT A NUMBER OF URBAN ROADS SOUTH OF TOWN ALONG ELKFORN CREEK DRAINING OFF OF CASPER MOUNTAIN.
